settings.proposal_contract: one strict candidate JSON object per independently issued OpenAI-compatible request; the portfolio prompt assigns each request a distinct factor focus, and the shared reservoir validates source membership and removes duplicates
settings.proposal_sampling: 64 independent one-candidate requests by default; portfolio_v1 uses deterministic focus allocations plus task-specific roles, and the local worker limit defaults to 64 without refill requests
settings.method: empirical-q0 LDM proposal distribution, q0-weighted maintenance of a 32-candidate BO pool, factor-aware categorical ARD GP-UCB scoring, and acquisition-tilted sampling
